description: This repo's overrides, merged on top of the shared preset (renovate/default.json) that renovate.yml passes as global config. See docs/renovate.md#this-repos-renovatejson.

customManagers.description: The osv-scanner image that image-scan runs (internal/imagescan's ScannerImage, see docs/image-scan.md) is a Go string constant, which no manager reads, so this tracks it as the Docker image it is, tag and digest.
